title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 6,751–6,800 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 頂級交響音樂廳建築聲學工程設計的；原聲的

examples.en: World-class acoustic engineering ensures that every musical note reaches the furthest balcony seat clearly.
examples.zh: 世界級「建築聲學工程」（Acoustic Engineering），確保每個微小音符皆能清晰傳遞至最遠的三樓包廂。

examples.en: The folk trio performed an unplugged acoustic concert that captivated the entire university audience.
examples.zh: 這支民謠三重唱樂團舉辦了一場不插電原聲音樂會，以純粹真摯的樂聲深深打動全場大學師生。

examples.en: Recording engineers treated the studio walls with acoustic foam to eliminate harsh room flutter.
examples.zh: 錄音工程師在錄音室牆面鋪設專業聲學吸音泡棉，徹底消除室內刺耳的顫動回音干擾。

words.definition: 滿座兩秒之交響音樂廳最佳殘響時間 (RT60)

examples.en: A two-second reverberation time lends orchestral music rich warmth and majestic spaciousness.
examples.zh: 長達兩秒的「滿座殘響時間」（Reverberation Time），賦予管弦交響樂宏大深邃的溫暖空間感。

examples.en: In the tiled bathroom, her singing voice gained pleasant reverberation that sounded like a cathedral.
examples.zh: 在鋪滿磁磚的浴室裡，她的歌聲獲得了悅耳生動的自然殘響回音，宛如置身宏偉大教堂一般。

examples.en: Sound engineers installed heavy velvet drapes to reduce excessive reverberation during lecture presentations.
examples.zh: 音響工程師加裝厚重天鵝絨布幔，以大幅抑制大型演講廳內過長的混濁殘響時間。

words.definition: 葡萄園梯田式環繞型現代音樂廳格局 (衛武營)；葡萄園

examples.en: The contemporary vineyard layout arranges terraced seating blocks around a centrally positioned stage.
examples.zh: 衛武營採用的現代「葡萄園梯田式格局」（Vineyard Layout），將觀眾席如梯田般環繞中央舞台佈置。

examples.en: Rolling green hills in central Taiwan host a boutique vineyard producing award-winning domestic wines.
examples.zh: 台灣中部起伏翠綠的丘陵上坐落著一處精品葡萄園酒莊，精釀出屢獲國際大獎肯定的在地名酒。

examples.en: Touring the family-owned French vineyard allowed visitors to sample crisp white wine straight from oak barrels.
examples.zh: 參觀這座歷史悠久的家族葡萄酒莊園，遊客得以直接從橡木桶中品嚐剛熟成出桶的清洌白葡萄酒。

words.definition: 經典長方形鞋盒式傳統聲學音樂廳 (維也納金色大廳)；鞋盒

examples.en: Classical shoebox halls are renowned for producing strong lateral sound reflections that hug the listener.
examples.zh: 經典「鞋盒式音樂廳」（Shoebox Hall），以提供豐沛的兩側側向聲音反射、營造絕佳包覆感而聞名全球。

examples.en: She kept cherished childhood photographs and handwritten letters neatly stored inside a vintage shoebox.
examples.zh: 她將一張張珍貴泛黃的童年老照片與手寫泛黃信件，整整齊齊珍藏在一只復古紙質舊鞋盒中。

examples.en: Urban students living in cramped shoebox apartments learn to maximize every square meter of living space.
examples.zh: 居住在市中心狹小如鞋盒般微型套房裡的大學生，學會了極致利用每一平方公尺的居住收納空間。

words.definition: 獨奏鋼琴微弱觸鍵之清脆晶瑩聲音清晰度；清晰

examples.en: Exceptional acoustic clarity allows listeners to distinguish individual flute trills within a full orchestral fortissimo.
examples.zh: 極致的「聲學清晰度」（Clarity），讓聽眾即使在全樂團最強奏中，依然能清晰分辨長笛細膩的顫音。

examples.en: The crystal-clear mountain stream flowed with such clarity that swimming trout were easily visible.
examples.zh: 高山溪澗清洌甘甜，水質澄澈純淨到連在卵石間悠游穿梭的野生鱒魚都清晰可見。

examples.en: The economics professor explained complex monetary inflation theories with admirable simplicity and clarity.
examples.zh: 這位經濟學名教授以令人讚嘆的深入淺出與條理分明，清晰透徹地剖析了繁複的貨幣通膨理論。

words.definition: 低音大提琴與法國號深沉溫暖之低頻音色豐潤度；溫暖

examples.en: Generous timber paneling enhances acoustic warmth, giving double basses a deep, resonant bloom.
examples.zh: 大面積實木護牆板大幅增強了「聲音溫暖度」（Warmth），讓低音大提琴呈現深沉渾厚的共鳴。

examples.en: Sitting beside the crackling brick hearth fire, she savored the comforting warmth of hot ginger tea.
examples.zh: 坐在劈啪作響的磚造壁爐火旁，她細細品啜著熱薑茶帶來的驅寒舒暢與溫暖暖意。

examples.en: The host welcomed international exchange students with genuine personal warmth and generous hospitality.
examples.zh: 主辦家庭以無比真摯由衷的個人親和溫暖與慷慨好客，熱情迎接遠道而來的各國國際交換學生。

words.definition: 被三維立體交響樂完全包圍之聲場包覆感

examples.en: Strong lateral reflections create spatial envelopment, making listeners feel bathed in sound from all sides.
examples.zh: 強勁的側向反射音創造出完美的「聲場包覆感」（Envelopment），讓聽眾感到整個人沉浸在音符海洋中。

examples.en: Thick coastal morning fog caused the complete visual envelopment of harbor lighthouses and sailboats.
examples.zh: 清晨沿海瀰漫的濃密海霧，造成港口外海燈塔與點點帆船完全隱沒在一片白茫茫的霧氣包圍之中。

examples.en: The surround-sound home theater system delivers stunning audio envelopment during action movie battle scenes.
examples.zh: 這套多聲道環繞家庭劇院音響系統，在動作電影激烈交火場景中帶來身歷其境的震撼聲音包覆感。

words.definition: 縮短舞台與觀眾席心理距離之視聽親密感；親密

examples.en: Curved terraced balconies foster acoustic intimacy, connecting patrons intimately with solo violinists.
examples.zh: 微弧形梯田包廂營造出極佳的「視聽親密感」（Intimacy），拉近了全場聽眾與小提琴獨奏家的心靈距離。

examples.en: Sharing heartfelt hopes and vulnerabilities deepens emotional intimacy between lifelong romantic partners.
examples.zh: 彼此毫無保留地分享心底深處的願景與脆弱，能深刻加深終身伴侶之間細水長流的情感親密連結。

examples.en: The coffee shop’s dim lighting and plush corner booths provide a sense of cozy conversational intimacy.
examples.zh: 街角咖啡館柔和昏黃的暖色照明與角落舒適的絨布卡座，營造出一種溫馨放鬆的私密談心氛圍。

words.definition: 天花板懸掛可升降調諧之曲面聲學反射板；反射器

examples.en: Suspended curved sound reflectors bounce early acoustic energy down into audience seats instantly.
examples.zh: 懸掛於天花板的「曲面聲學反射板」（Reflectors），能將珍貴的早期反射聲波第一時間精準投射至觀眾席。

examples.en: Bicycle commuters clip orange safety reflectors onto wheel spokes to ensure visibility after nightfall.
examples.zh: 單車夜騎通勤族在輪圈輻條上卡上橘色夜光反光片，確保在夜幕降臨後享有清晰的行車警示度。

examples.en: Road workers installed red cat-eye reflectors along the highway center line to guide nighttime drivers.
examples.zh: 公路養護工人在國道中央分向線上鋪設紅色的貓眼反光標記，指引夜間行車駕駛人保持安全車道。

words.definition: 舞台上方可調高低之交響樂團聲音反射天篷；天篷

examples.en: Lowering the acoustic canopy over the stage allows chamber musicians to hear each other with precision.
examples.zh: 降下舞台正上方的「聲學調音天篷」（Acoustic Canopy），能讓室內樂演奏家在舞台上清晰聆聽彼此的配合。

examples.en: Monkeys and colorful parrots leap between branches high up in the dense tropical rainforest canopy.
examples.zh: 靈巧的猴群與羽色華麗的金剛鸚鵡，在熱帶雨林高聳茂密的樹冠層枝椏間歡快跳躍穿梭。

examples.en: Wedding guests mingled happily beneath the white striped fabric canopy pitched on the lawn.
examples.zh: 參加戶外婚禮的親朋好友，在草坪上搭建的白條紋歐風遮陽帳篷天篷下開心地互相寒暄敬酒。

words.definition: 二次餘數聲學擴散板 (消除回音殘響與顫動)；擴散器

examples.en: Quadratic residue diffusers scatter high-frequency sound waves evenly across the hall without absorbing energy.
examples.zh: 專利「二次餘數聲學擴散板」（Diffusers），在不消耗聲能的前提下將高頻聲波均勻散射至全場每個角落。

examples.en: She added a few drops of pure lavender essential oil to the ceramic ultrasonic aroma diffuser on her nightstand.
examples.zh: 她在床頭櫃上的陶瓷超音波水氧芳香機擴香儀中滴入數滴純薰衣草精油，營造助眠舒壓的芬芳。

examples.en: Camera flash units equipped with a plastic diffuser produce soft, flattering portrait lighting without harsh shadows.
examples.zh: 照相機外接閃光燈加裝柔光擴散罩，能打出柔和均勻的人像光線，有效消除臉上生硬的生硬陰影。

words.definition: 凸面實木微弧形擴散牆板 (均勻散射聲波) 的

examples.en: Gentle convex wood panels on sidewalls break up focused focal reflections and eliminate harsh flutter.
examples.zh: 側牆上微凸的「實木凸面擴散板」（Convex Panels），能打散聚焦點反射並徹底消除刺耳的顫動回音。

examples.en: Store security teams monitor blind aisles using large convex mirrors mounted in upper room corners.
examples.zh: 店面安控保全人員利用安裝在賣場挑高牆角的寬幅凸面廣角反光鏡，隨時監看走道盲區死角。

examples.en: An automobile side-view mirror utilizes a slightly convex glass surface to widen the driver’s field of vision.
examples.zh: 汽車兩側後視鏡採用微凸面曲面鏡片，能顯著擴展行車後方視野角度，減少切換車道時的視覺死角。

words.definition: 劇院座椅天鵝絨吸音布料之精準吸音係數；吸收

examples.en: Calculating porous sound absorption prevents muddy low-frequency buildup inside the large auditorium.
examples.zh: 精確計算多孔材料的「聲能吸收係數」（Absorption），能有效防止低頻轟鳴在大劇院內過度堆積。

examples.en: The human digestive tract facilitates the optimal nutrient absorption of dietary vitamins and minerals.
examples.zh: 人體小腸消化道具備豐富微絨毛結構，能極大化促進食物中各類維生素與微量礦物質的消化吸收。

examples.en: The rapid market absorption of electric vehicles surprised legacy automotive manufacturers globally.
examples.zh: 電動車在消費市場上展現出的驚人消化接納速度，讓全球傳統老牌燃油車巨頭大感震撼與驚異。

words.definition: 依頻率精確量測之材料吸音與散射聲學係數；係數

examples.en: Laboratory measurements verify the sound absorption coefficient of acoustic plaster at multiple frequencies.
examples.zh: 嚴密的實驗室測試精確測定了特種聲學抹灰在各個音頻下的「吸音與散射係數」（Coefficient）。

examples.en: Aeronautical engineers calculate the aerodynamic drag coefficient of high-speed train bullet noses in wind tunnels.
examples.zh: 航太流體力學工程師在大型風洞實驗室中，精確測定出高速子彈列車流線型車頭的空氣風阻係數。

examples.en: The friction coefficient between wet tires and asphalt decreases sharply during sudden torrential downpours.
examples.zh: 輪胎與柏油路面之間的摩擦係數，在突如其來的午後傾盆雷陣雨中會因路面水膜而急遽滑落。

words.definition: 徹底消除平行牆面之顫動回音與空間駐波；回音

examples.en: Angled geometry and textured surfaces eliminate flutter echo between opposing parallel side walls.
examples.zh: 傾斜的非平行牆面設計搭配立體幾何紋理，徹底消除了平行側牆之間發生的「顫動回音」（Flutter Echo）。

examples.en: The lost mountaineer shouted loudly into the vast canyon, listening for the faint returning echo of his voice.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客朝著空曠深邃的大峽谷大聲呼喊求救，屏息傾聽自己悠遠聲音在岩壁間傳回的微弱回聲。

examples.en: The prime minister’s impassioned speech seemed to echo the deep frustrations felt by working-class families.
examples.zh: 內閣總理發表的這場慷慨激昂施政演說，深刻呼應並共鳴了廣大基層勞工家庭長久以來的生計無奈。

words.definition: 調諧大廳自然空腔共鳴頻率 (消除低頻駐波)；共鳴

examples.en: Tuned Helmholtz resonance cavities behind wooden slats absorb problematic mid-bass frequencies smoothly.
examples.zh: 隱藏在木格柵後方的「亥姆霍茲共振腔體」（Resonance Cavities），能平穩吸收干擾聽感的特定中低頻駐波。

examples.en: The deep resonance of the cello filled the stone cathedral with a profound and somber warmth.
examples.zh: 大提琴深沉悠揚的醇厚共振琴音，讓整座石造大教堂瀰漫著一股莊嚴肅穆又溫暖動人的氛圍。

examples.en: The historic novel found extraordinary emotional resonance among young readers navigating modern life transitions.
examples.zh: 這部厚重的歷史小說，在正面臨人生階段轉折起伏的年輕讀者群中引發了極為強烈的心靈共鳴。

words.definition: 盒中盒 (Box-in-a-Box) 雙層懸浮建築隔音工法；隔離

examples.en: Double-hull box-in-a-box isolation prevents subway rumble from infiltrating the quiet performance chamber.
examples.zh: 採用頂級「盒中盒雙層隔音工法」（Isolation），完全阻絕了鄰近地下捷運與地面車流的低頻震動。

examples.en: Severe mountain snowstorms left the remote alpine village in complete geographical isolation for three weeks.
examples.zh: 狂暴猛烈的高山暴風雪，讓這座深山偏遠的高山小村落陷入長達三週對外交通完全斷絕的孤立狀態。

examples.en: Contagious virus patients were promptly placed in negative-pressure isolation wards to prevent ward outbreaks.
examples.zh: 確診高傳染性病毒的患者在第一時間被妥善安置在負壓隔離病房中，嚴密防範院內交叉感染傳播。

words.definition: 放置於重型彈簧減震器上之懸浮地板結構的；漂浮的

examples.en: The auditorium rests on an isolated floating concrete slab supported by hundreds of heavy steel springs.
examples.zh: 整個音樂廳基座坐落在由數百個重型鋼製彈簧支撐的「獨立懸浮混凝土大底板」（Floating Slab）之上。

examples.en: Colorful lotus blossoms bobbed gently atop the floating green water lily leaves on the tranquil pond.
examples.zh: 嬌豔脫俗的粉紅睡蓮花朵，在靜謐池塘水面上一片片翠綠漂浮的睡蓮荷葉間迎風輕輕搖曳。

examples.en: Central banks adopt floating currency exchange rate mechanisms determined by international supply and demand.
examples.zh: 現代多國中央銀行採取由國際外匯市場供需自由決定的浮動匯率機制，保持貨幣政策彈性。

words.definition: 阻絕外部捷運震動之重型鋼製螺旋減震彈簧；彈簧

examples.en: Large helical steel springs decouple the concert hall foundation from surrounding urban vibrations.
examples.zh: 巨型「螺旋鋼製減震彈簧」（Steel Springs），將音樂廳地基與周遭繁忙都市的劇烈震動完全彈性解耦。

examples.en: Fresh cherry blossoms blanketed the countryside in brilliant pink hues as warm spring arrived.
examples.zh: 隨著溫暖宜人的春天悄然降臨，漫山遍野盛開的嬌豔櫻花將整片鄉村原野妝點得粉嫩動人。

examples.en: The old coil mattress lost its resilience as rusted interior metal springs began poking through the padding.
examples.zh: 這張老舊的彈簧床墊逐漸失去了應有的回彈支撐力，內部生鏽的螺旋彈簧甚至開始頂穿表層墊料。

words.definition: 牆體與地基結構彈性斷橋物理聲學解耦工法

examples.en: Structural decoupling ensures that impact noise cannot travel through concrete columns into the auditorium.
examples.zh: 嚴密的「結構彈性解耦工法」（Decoupling），確保任何撞擊與腳步聲皆無法透過樑柱傳入演奏大廳內部。

examples.en: Economists debate whether economic decoupling between major superpowers is feasible in a globalized supply chain.
examples.zh: 經濟學界熱烈論辯，在深度全球化供應鏈盤根錯節的今日，兩大強權經濟實體全面脫鉤是否具備可行性。

examples.en: Decoupling carbon emissions growth from GDP expansion represents the gold standard of green industrial policy.
examples.zh: 達成國內生產毛額（GDP）穩健增長與碳排放總量持續下降的實質脫鉤，是綠色永續產業政策的最高境界。

words.definition: 低於每秒一公尺之極慢無聲層流空調風速；速度

examples.en: HVAC air enters silently under seats at an imperceptibly gentle airflow velocity of 0.5 meters per second.
examples.zh: 空調冷風以每秒僅零點五公尺的「極微低風速」（Airflow Velocity），從座椅下方靜悄悄緩慢滲出。

examples.en: The pitcher threw a fastball that reached an astonishing velocity of ninety-eight miles per hour on the radar gun.
examples.zh: 該明星王牌投手全力投出一記火球直球，球場測速槍上瞬間亮出高達時速九十八英里的驚人球速。

examples.en: Rocket propulsion systems generate tremendous exhaust velocity to escape Earth's deep gravitational well.
examples.zh: 火箭燃燒推進系統向後噴射出極高速度的高溫氣體排氣速度，方能擺脫地球深邃的重力井束縛。

words.definition: 內襯高效吸音棉之超大型消音中央空調風管；管道

examples.en: Oversized air distribution ducts lined with thick acoustic glass wool eliminate turbulent rushing air hiss.
examples.zh: 內襯厚實聲學玻璃棉的超大截面「空調通風風管」（Ducts），徹底消除了空氣湍流摩擦的嘶嘶風切聲。

examples.en: Tear ducts located in the inner corner of our eyelids drain excess moisture into the nasal cavity.
examples.zh: 位於人類眼瞼內側眼角處的細微淚管，能順暢地將眼球表面分泌的多餘淚液自然引流至鼻腔中。

examples.en: Electricians ran insulated electrical conduits through a designated underfloor service duct in the server room.
examples.zh: 水電工程師將各類絕緣電纜管線，整齊有序地鋪設穿過電腦伺服器機房專屬的高架地板下管線管道。

words.definition: 空調出風口大型高效阻抗式消音器葉片；消音器

examples.en: Multi-stage in-line duct silencers attenuate fan motor vibrations before chilled air enters the hall.
examples.zh: 多級大型「風道管路消音器」（Duct Silencers），在冷氣送入大廳前將送風機馬達的低頻轟鳴全數衰減。

examples.en: Gunsmiths attach a firearm silencer to muffle the deafening muzzle blast of high-powered hunting rifles.
examples.zh: 槍械師傅在獵槍槍口加裝消音器裝置，以大幅減輕大威力狩獵步槍射擊時震耳欲聾的槍口爆音衝擊。

examples.en: Exhaust silencers mounted beneath sports motorcycles dampen combustion engine roar to comply with noise laws.
examples.zh: 重型打檔機車底盤下方安裝的高效率排氣管消音器，能有效抑制內燃機引擎咆哮以符合環保噪音法規。

words.definition: 達成 NC-15 極致靜謐環境極低背景噪音標準；噪音

examples.en: The hall meets the ultra-stringent NC-15 ambient noise criterion, where even a pin drop can be heard.
examples.zh: 音樂廳達成極端嚴苛的 NC-15「超靜音背景噪音標準」（Ambient Noise），全場靜謐到一根針掉地都清晰可辨。

examples.en: Construction noise from the metro expansion outside our window made concentrating on study very difficult.
examples.zh: 窗外捷運延伸工程傳來的沉重打樁營造噪音，讓坐在書桌前準備升學考試的學子難以靜心專注。

examples.en: Signal processing filters eliminate background electronic noise from delicate satellite radio recordings.
examples.zh: 數位訊號處理濾波器能有效過濾消除微弱人造衛星無線電訊號接收中夾雜的各類微小電子雜訊背景噪音。

words.definition: 國際音樂廳噪音評定準則 (NC 噪音曲線等級)；準則

examples.en: Achieving a Noise Criterion (NC) rating below 15 requires extensive silencing across all mechanical systems.
examples.zh: 想要達到「噪音評定準則」（Noise Criterion NC）15 級以下的極限標準，必須對全館所有機電進行深度消音。

examples.en: Academic integrity and genuine research passion served as the primary criterion for selecting scholarship winners.
examples.zh: 學術誠信與對學術探究的真實熱忱，是評審委員會遴選今年度頂尖出國獎學金得主的最高核心準則。

examples.en: Financial institutions evaluate credit score history as a crucial criterion when reviewing mortgage applications.
examples.zh: 各家金融行庫在嚴格審核購屋房貸申請時，將申請人過往的聯徵個人信用評分紀錄列為關鍵核貸準則。

words.definition: 歷經數十年天然風乾熟成之頂級共鳴實木板材；木材

examples.en: Walls are clad in seasoned resonant oak timber, chosen for its balanced tonal response across registers.
examples.zh: 牆面全面鋪設經數十年風乾熟成的「頂級共鳴橡木」（Oak Timber），具備全頻段極度平衡的溫潤聲學響應。

examples.en: Loggers transported sustainably harvested pine timber down the river to the regional sawmills.
examples.zh: 伐木林班工人將兼顧永續林業伐採的高山紅松原木木材，順著溪流放流運往山腳下的地方木材加工廠。

examples.en: The traditional Taiwanese historical courtyard residence was constructed using aromatic cypress timber.
examples.zh: 這棟保存完好的台灣傳統閩南式歷史三合院古厝，全棟主要樑柱皆採用散發天然香氣的珍貴台灣檜木木料建造。

words.definition: 高密度緻密硬木牆面護牆板 (完美反射全音域)

examples.en: Heavy solid wood cladding prevents diaphragmatic low-frequency absorption, keeping bass punchy and alive.
examples.zh: 厚實緻密的「實木牆面護板」（Wood Cladding），防止低頻能量被薄板吸收，保持低音結實飽滿且充滿生命力。

examples.en: Modern office towers feature reflective double-glazed glass cladding that lowers building cooling costs.
examples.zh: 現代智慧商辦大樓外牆普遍採用雙層節能鍍膜玻璃帷幕外牆覆板，能大幅降低炎炎夏日的建築空調製冷耗能。

examples.en: Exterior aluminum composite cladding gives the municipal sports center a sleek, futuristic appearance.
examples.zh: 建築外牆全面包覆高科技鋁複合帷幕外層覆板，賦予這座市立現代國民運動中心洗練前衛的未來感風貌。

words.definition: 塗抹於牆面保護音色通透之天然樂器專用生漆；生漆

examples.en: Artisans hand-applied breathable traditional instrument lacquer over wall surfaces to seal porous pores.
examples.zh: 匠人以手工在木牆表面塗抹透氣的「傳統樂器天然生漆」（Lacquer），封閉微孔同時維持木材透亮音色。

examples.en: Japanese master craftsmen apply dozens of glossy black lacquer layers to create exquisite tableware boxes.
examples.zh: 日本漆藝國寶大師經過數月繁複手工工序反覆刷塗數十層深黑大漆生漆，精心打造出華貴沉穩的漆器便當盒。

examples.en: Woodworkers carefully lacquer antique rosewood dining tables to safeguard the polished grain from water rings.
examples.zh: 細木工匠細心在古董紫檀木大餐桌表面塗刷保護天然透明木器生漆，保護溫潤打磨木紋不受茶水杯印水漬侵害。

words.definition: 保持空座與滿座吸音量完全一致之專利聲學座椅；座位

examples.en: Acoustic theater seating is upholstered with specific foam to mimic the exact sound absorption of a seated human body.
examples.zh: 專利「聲學座椅」（Acoustic Seating），其特殊泡棉能精準模擬人體吸音量，使空座與坐滿時的殘響完全一致。

examples.en: The new outdoor stadium expanded its spectator seating capacity to accommodate fifty thousand sports fans.
examples.zh: 全新落成啟用的現代化室外綜合體育場大幅擴建了觀眾看台座位容量，足以容納多達五萬名熱血體育迷。

examples.en: Restaurant hosts arranged flexible table seating configurations to host the large corporate banquet party.
examples.zh: 餐廳領檯主管靈活調整包廂內部的餐桌桌椅座位擺設動線，從容迎接即將抵達的百人大型企業尾牙春酒宴席。

words.definition: 無論觀眾人數多寡皆維持恆定之音樂廳聲學品質；入座

examples.en: Sound characteristics remain perfectly uniform whether the hall is at full capacity or thirty percent occupancy.
examples.zh: 無論是全場爆滿或是僅三成「觀眾入座率」（Occupancy），音樂廳的聲學殘響與清晰度皆維持驚人的一致。

examples.en: Hotel room occupancy rates along the sun-drenched southern coast peak during the warm spring holidays.
examples.zh: 坐落於豔陽高照南台灣沿海線的頂級觀光度假飯店客房住宿住房率，在春節連續假期期間衝上最高峰。

examples.en: Fire safety regulations strictly dictate the maximum legal occupancy limit permitted inside the nightclub.
examples.zh: 內政部消防法規對密閉式視聽娛樂場所與夜店酒吧內部，明文頒訂了嚴格的法定最高安全容留人數入座上限。

words.definition: 隱藏於木格柵後方之電動可伸縮調音吸音布幕；窗簾

examples.en: Motorized acoustic wool curtains deploy from hidden ceiling pockets to adjust reverberation for amplified jazz concerts.
examples.zh: 隱藏式「電動羊毛吸音布幕」（Acoustic Curtains），在舉辦爵士與流行電聲音樂會時迅速展開以縮短殘響。

examples.en: She drew the thick velvet curtains shut to block out bright morning streetlights and sleep in late.
examples.zh: 她隨手拉緊厚實遮光的天鵝絨窗簾以完全隔絕清晨刺眼的街燈與晨曦，安心享受週末難得的補眠時光。

examples.en: The stage crew waited backstage for the heavy red velvet theater curtains to part before the play commenced.
examples.zh: 舞台後台全體工作人員屏息待命，靜候沉重華麗的大紅天鵝絨戲劇布幕徐徐拉開，宣告年度大戲正式開演。

words.definition: 可在交響樂、歌劇與演講間自由切換之可變聲學彈性

examples.en: Deployable acoustic banners provide the hall with high operational variability for diverse musical genres.
examples.zh: 可升降吸音旗幟賦予了這座多功能音樂廳強大的「聲學可變彈性」（Variability），完美相容各類演出型態。

examples.en: Extreme rainfall variability across seasons poses significant challenges for municipal water reservoir management.
examples.zh: 四季之間極端懸殊的降雨量季節波動變化性，為全島各地民生水庫的水資源蓄水調度帶來了巨大的嚴峻挑戰。

examples.en: Agricultural scientists study the genetic variability within wild wheat varieties to breed drought-tolerant crops.
examples.zh: 農業遺傳科學家深入研究野生小麥原生種內部豐富的基因遺傳變異性，以培育出耐乾旱極端氣候的優質新品種。

words.definition: 舞台兩側可開啟厚重混凝土閥門之大型殘響室；房間

examples.en: Opening motorized doors to the echo chambers adds thousands of cubic meters of reverberant air space.
examples.zh: 開啟通往舞台兩側巨型「殘響室」（Reverberation Chambers）的電動厚門，能瞬間注入數千立方公尺的殘響空間。

examples.en: The city council members gathered inside the municipal council chamber to debate the annual budget bill.
examples.zh: 全體市議員齊聚於市議會議事大廳內，針對下年度地方政府總預算編列審查案展開激烈審查辯論。

examples.en: Ancient subterranean burial chambers carved into solid limestone cliffs were unearthed by archaeologists.
examples.zh: 考古學家在岩溶石灰岩險峻懸崖深處，意外發掘開鑿出深埋地底數千年的古老地下墓室石室。

words.definition: 透過殘響室連通調節音樂廳整體有效立方體積；體積

examples.en: The physical volume per seat ratio determines the maximum natural reverberation time attainable in the space.
examples.zh: 每個座位的平均「空間聲學體積」（Acoustic Volume），決定了該音樂廳所能達到的天然最長殘響極限。

examples.en: Please turn down the television speaker volume so your sleeping baby sister is not woken up.
examples.zh: 請隨手調低客廳電視機的喇叭播放音量，以免驚醒正在臥室嬰兒床上甜甜熟睡的小妹妹。

examples.en: The university library preserves an irreplaceable rare book volume bound in hand-stitched pigskin vellum.
examples.zh: 大學總圖書館特藏室悉心珍藏著一卷舉世無雙的珍罕中世紀羊皮手抄典籍善本。

words.definition: 3D 虛擬音樂廳聲學波場高精度電腦數值模擬；模擬

examples.en: Computer simulation models sound wave propagation, predicting echo patterns before construction begins.
examples.zh: 透過先進的電腦「聲學數值模擬」（Simulation），在動工興建前即可精準預測全場各座位的聲波擴散路徑。

examples.en: Pilot trainees spend hundreds of flight hours practicing emergency landings inside a flight cockpit simulation.
examples.zh: 培訓民航飛行員必須在全動態飛行駕駛艙模擬器中完成數百小時嚴格訓練，反覆熟練緊急迫降應變SOP。

examples.en: Climate scientists run supercomputer climate simulation models to project sea level rise over the next century.
examples.zh: 氣候科學家運用超級電腦運算全球氣候模擬預測模型，以精確推估下個世紀全球海平面上升幅度。

words.definition: 追蹤數百萬條聲線反射路徑之電腦光線追蹤演算法

examples.en: Acoustic ray-tracing software calculates sound energy distribution across every tier of the auditorium.
examples.zh: 運用聲學「聲線追蹤演算法」（Ray-Tracing），精密計算數百萬條聲波反射線在各層看台上的能量分布。

examples.en: Modern graphics rendering engines utilize hardware ray-tracing to generate realistic reflections on glass windows.
examples.zh: 現代尖端遊戲圖形渲染引擎善用硬體光線追蹤技術，在水面與玻璃窗上即時生成栩栩如生的逼真光影倒影。

examples.en: Optical engineers apply geometric ray-tracing algorithms to design distortion-free camera lenses for smartphones.
examples.zh: 光學工程師應用幾何光線追蹤演算法，精心為旗艦智慧型手機研發微型且零畸變的高解析相機鏡頭模組。

words.definition: 十分之一精準實體縮尺模型超音波充氮聲學測試；比例

examples.en: Engineers built a 1:10 physical scale model filled with dry nitrogen to test ultrasonic sound reflections.
examples.zh: 工程團隊耗資打造「一比十精密實體縮尺模型」（Scale Model），充入乾燥氮氣以超音波驗證聲學設計。

examples.en: Step onto the digital bathroom scale every morning to track your body weight progress consistently.
examples.zh: 每天清晨起床後踏上浴室數位體重秤，能持之以恆、客觀精準地掌握自身的體重管理進度。

examples.en: The seismologist categorized the major earthquake as a magnitude seven point two on the Richter scale.
examples.zh: 地震測報中心專業地震學家，將這起外海強震正式判定為芮氏規模七點二的強烈地震。

words.definition: 散佈於模型各座位之高靈敏度微型全向測量麥克風；麥克風

examples.en: Miniature measurement microphones placed on toy-sized seats recorded sound pressure levels accurately.
examples.zh: 安裝在模型微型座椅上的「高靈敏度測量麥克風」（Microphones），精確記錄全場各頻段的聲壓分佈。

examples.en: The keynote speaker stepped up to the podium and adjusted the wireless microphone before beginning his speech.
examples.zh: 開場專題主講人穩健步上講台，在正式開講前將講台上的鵝頸式無線麥克風調整至最適合的高度。

examples.en: Professional podcast creators invest in dynamic studio microphones to ensure crisp and warm vocal broadcasts.
examples.zh: 專業優質播客創作者不惜重金添購錄音室等級動圈麥克風，確保播客音質清晰飽滿、溫潤純淨。

words.definition: 電火花高能量脈衝響應聲學測量 (測量各頻段衰減)；脈衝

examples.en: Firing a starter pistol generates an acoustic impulse response that reveals the hall's true decay profile.
examples.zh: 鳴放發令槍產生瞬間高能量「聲學脈衝響應」（Impulse Response），精準揭示大廳在各頻率下的衰減曲線。

examples.en: He resisted the sudden childish impulse to spend his entire paycheck on an expensive antique watch.
examples.zh: 他理智地克制住了當下那股孩子氣的衝動購物慾望，沒有將剛入帳的薪水全拿去買昂貴的古董名錶。

examples.en: Nerve cells transmit electrical impulses across synaptic junctions at speeds of hundreds of feet per second.
examples.zh: 人體神經細胞以每秒數百英尺的極快電位速度，跨越突觸間隙向大腦與肢體肌肉傳遞生物微弱電脈衝信號。

words.definition: 邀請世界級交響樂團進駐現場逐座細緻調音工藝；調音

examples.en: On-site acoustic tuning involved months of listening tests with full orchestras adjusting panel angles.
examples.zh: 歷時數月的「現場聲學細部調音」（Tuning），邀請頂尖交響樂團進駐，在實際演奏中微調每一片反射板角度。

examples.en: The pianist listened intently while the technician was tuning the concert grand piano for the evening recital.
examples.zh: 鋼琴大師站在一旁全神貫注屏息傾聽，經驗老到的調音技師正細心為晚間獨奏會的大型平台鋼琴進行微調音準。

examples.en: Fine-tuning the database indexes significantly slashed search query response times from seconds to milliseconds.
examples.zh: 針對大型資料庫查詢索引進行深度微調與架構最佳化，成功將繁複搜尋的系統響應時間自數秒驟降至幾毫秒。

words.definition: 建築流線美學造型與純淨音響之完美和諧統一

examples.en: The hall achieves a sublime harmony between organic sculptural curves and mathematical acoustic physics.
examples.zh: 這座宏偉殿堂在有機流線雕塑造型與嚴密數學聲學物理之間，達成了令人屏息的「完美和諧」（Harmony）。

examples.en: The four singers blended their distinct voices into breathtaking vocal harmony that moved the audience.
examples.zh: 四位聲樂家將各自獨具特色動人的聲線天衣無縫交融，編織出動人心弦的純淨四部和聲天籟。

examples.en: Traditional Asian philosophies encourage human beings to cultivate deep harmony with the surrounding natural environment.
examples.zh: 東方傳統哲學智慧歷久彌新，長年倡導人類心靈應與周遭大自然天地生息涵養深沉的和諧共生之道。

words.definition: 衛武營如巨大白浪翻湧起伏之建築曲線優雅美感；優雅

examples.en: The flowing silver roof sweeps gracefully across the landscape with majestic architectural elegance.
examples.zh: 衛武營銀白色的流線屋頂如巨浪般在平原上優雅起伏，展現出極致的「現代建築優雅美感」（Elegance）。

examples.en: She walked down the gala staircase with effortless dignity and timeless personal elegance.
examples.zh: 她步下晚宴中央旋轉樓梯時儀態雍容大方，舉手投足間流露出一股歷久彌新、優雅迷人的高貴氣度。

examples.en: The mathematician solved the unsolved riddle using a proof praised by peers for its simplicity and elegance.
examples.zh: 這位青年數學大師成功破解了懸而未決的千古幾何難題，其論證過程因質樸精純而深獲同儕讚譽其優雅無雙。

words.definition: 百人大型管弦樂團馬勒交響曲之震撼磅礡演奏；交響樂

examples.en: When the brass section thundered in the climax of the symphony, the entire wooden hall resonated like a cello.
examples.zh: 當銅管樂部在「交響曲高潮」（Symphony）中齊聲咆哮時，整座木質音樂廳如同一把巨大的大提琴般共鳴震撼。

examples.en: Beethoven composed his triumphant Ninth Symphony despite suffering from severe hearing impairment.
examples.zh: 偉大音樂家貝多芬在飽受全聾聽力障礙折磨的晚年，依然創作出震撼萬古、歌頌歡樂與大愛的第九號交響曲。

examples.en: The sunrise over the misty tea plantation felt like a harmonious visual symphony of light and shadow.
examples.zh: 晨曦朝陽從雲霧繚繞的高山茶園稜線上緩緩升起，宛如一場光影與色彩在大地上交織譜寫出的視覺交響詩。

words.definition: 每一排觀眾皆能清晰捕捉之琴弓極弱微小細節；細微差異

examples.en: The acoustic intimacy lets listeners catch every subtle bow stroke nuance of the maestro’s violin solo.
examples.zh: 卓越的聲學親密感，讓後排觀眾也能清晰捕捉到大師小提琴獨奏中每一次運弓揉弦的「幽微細節」（Nuances）。

examples.en: Advanced language translators must understand cultural nuance to capture the true humor behind local idioms.
examples.zh: 頂尖高階外語口譯專家必須透徹理解在地文化底蘊與細微語感差異，方能精準傳達在地俚語背後的幽默感。

examples.en: The experienced tea master explained the flavor nuance separating spring flushes from winter harvested leaves.
examples.zh: 經驗老到的資深茶道大師如數家珍地向學員解析，春茶的清揚花香與冬茶的醇厚甘韻之間微妙的風味層次差異。

words.definition: 音樂穿透耳膜觸動心靈深處之精神情感共鳴；共鳴

examples.en: Great music performed in such pure acoustics evokes a deep, unforgettable spiritual resonance.
examples.zh: 在如此純淨天籟的聲學殿堂中聆聽偉大樂章，能在每位聽眾心底激盪起久久不散的「精神情感共鳴」（Resonance）。

examples.en: Magnetic resonance imaging provides detailed anatomical views without exposing patients to ionizing radiation.
examples.zh: 磁振造影（MRI）醫療掃描能在完全不讓病患暴露於游離輻射的前提下，呈現人體軟組織細膩的高解析影像。

examples.en: The activist’s call for universal healthcare equality struck a powerful chord of public resonance nationwide.
examples.zh: 這位社會倡議家為落實全民就醫平等而發出的真摯呼籲，在全國各階層社會大眾心中激盪起極為強烈的共鳴迴響。

words.definition: 矗立於南台灣藝文地標之世界級聲學藝術豐碑；紀念碑

examples.en: The National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts stands as a cultural monument celebrated across the world.
examples.zh: 衛武營國家藝術文化中心矗立於南台灣，已成為舉世聞名、滋養心靈的「世界級文化藝術豐碑」（Monument）。

examples.en: Tourists gathered in the central city square to photograph the bronze historical war memorial monument.
examples.zh: 觀光客絡繹不絕聚集在市中心中央廣場前，紛紛舉起相機與這座莊嚴肅穆的青銅歷史戰役紀念碑合影留念。

examples.en: Completing the cross-island highway across steep Central Range gorges stands as an engineering monument.
examples.zh: 在險峻陡峭的中央山脈深山峽谷間開鑿打通橫貫公路，是台灣土木水利史上令人肅然起敬的偉大工程豐碑。

words.definition: 隔絕塵世繁雜喧囂之純淨天籟音樂神聖殿堂；庇護所

examples.en: Stepping inside the quiet hall feels like entering a sacred sanctuary dedicated entirely to the beauty of sound.
examples.zh: 踏入這座極致靜謐的大廳，宛如走進一座遠離塵囂、完全獻給純淨聲音美學的「神聖音樂殿堂」（Sanctuary）。

examples.en: The wildlife sanctuary provides a secure breeding habitat for endangered Formosan black bears and serows.
examples.zh: 這處國家級野生動物重要棲息環境生態保護區，為瀕臨絕種的台灣黑熊與台灣長鬃山羊提供了安全的繁殖庇護所。

examples.en: Her cozy home study with a garden view serves as a peaceful quiet sanctuary after stressful corporate days.
examples.zh: 窗外坐擁滿庭綠意的溫馨居家書房，是她在經歷高壓緊繃的職場會議後最放鬆舒壓的避風港聖殿。

words.definition: 聆聽終曲全場合唱之靈魂昇華超越感；卓越

examples.en: The final choral movement swept the audience into an overwhelming state of spiritual transcendence.
examples.zh: 貝多芬第九號交響曲終曲合唱響徹大廳的瞬間，將全場觀眾帶入一種難以言喻的「靈魂昇華超越境界」（Transcendence）。

examples.en: Great literature achieves philosophical transcendence by addressing universal human longings across eras.
examples.zh: 真正不朽的偉大文學經典之所以能超越時空維度，正在於其直指千百年來人類心靈共通的愛恨渴求與終極追尋。

examples.en: Mountain climbers reaching the misty Himalayan summit experienced moments of breathtaking mental transcendence.
examples.zh: 登山家歷經千辛萬苦終於登上雲霧繚繞的喜馬拉雅極峰之巔時，身心體會到了一種無與倫比、超脫塵世的靈魂昇華。

words.definition: 兩千名觀眾同頻呼吸、熱淚盈眶之純粹藝術喜悅；喜悅

examples.en: Standing ovations and thunderous applause reflected the profound auditory joy shared by the audience.
examples.zh: 全場兩千名聽眾起立熱烈鼓掌喝采，洋溢著沉浸在天籟之音中的「純粹藝術喜悅」（Auditory Joy）。

examples.en: Grandparents watched with immense joy as their young grandchildren opened colorful holiday gifts.
examples.zh: 祖父母慈祥看著活潑可愛的小孫子們興高采烈拆開包裝精美的節慶禮物，眉宇間流露出無比溫暖欣慰的喜悅。

examples.en: Cultivating a beautiful garden and sharing fresh blossoms with neighbors brings her genuine daily joy.
examples.zh: 親手在陽台蒔花弄草悉心照料花木，並隨手將現剪芬芳鮮花分送左右鄰居，為她的退休生活帶來純粹真實的快樂。

words.definition: 代代相傳、滋養無數世代心靈之永恆建築聲學遺產；遺產

examples.en: This magnificent acoustic masterpiece will inspire and nurture musical souls as an enduring cultural legacy.
examples.zh: 這座融合科技與美學的偉大聲學建築傑作，將作為滋養無數世代心靈的「永恆文化遺產」（Legacy）代代相傳。

examples.en: The philanthropist left a lasting educational legacy by establishing endowed scholarships for underprivileged youth.
examples.zh: 這位慈善教育家透過捐設永久性清寒優秀學子助學獎學金，為後世留下了功在教育、造福無數青年的長遠遺產。

examples.en: Ancient Greek philosophers left an intellectual legacy that continues to shape modern Western democratic thought.
examples.zh: 古希臘先哲所奠定的哲學思辨思想遺產，在數千年後的今天依然深刻啟發並塑造著當代西方民主政治思想體系。
